title: Apparatus Signals
summary: Which fire departments are about to sell a fire truck, in every US state: grants, orders, board votes and auction lots read into one ranked list, each with a likely listing window and, where the truck type is known, a guide price.

title: The cup note
summary: Starbucks told baristas to write a note on every cup. I ran the rollout 24 ways, through six store managers, twelve baristas and 96 customers played by a model, to see what actually hits the cup.

title: Rumor Town
summary: Start one rumor in a pixel-art town of 50 people and watch it spread, change, get doubted, and get set straight over one day.

title: The war premium
summary: An interactive chart of the Brent–WTI spread, 2021 to 2026 — what the market charges for war risk, in dollars per barrel.
